title: The Sword of the Lord Drawn

questions.question: Against what does the Lord tell Ezekiel to set his face, preach, and prophesy in Ezekiel 21:2?
options: Jerusalem / the sanctuaries / the land of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Jerusalem / the sanctuaries / the land of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:2 (ESV): "Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuaries. Prophesy against the land of Israel."

questions.question: What does the Lord God say He is drawing from its sheath against the land of Israel?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:3 (ESV): "and say to the land of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you and will draw my sword from its sheath..."

questions.question: Who does the Lord say He will cut off from the land of Israel with His sword?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:3 (ESV): "will draw my sword from its sheath and will cut off from you both righteous and wicked."

questions.question: What physical sign is Ezekiel told to exhibit before the people as a reflection of the coming news?
options: Sigh with breaking heart and bitter grief
Tear his clothes and put ashes on his head
Sit in total silence for three days
questions.correctAnswer: Sigh with breaking heart and bitter grief
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:6 (ESV): "Sigh therefore, son of man; sigh with breaking heart and bitter grief before their eyes."

questions.question: When the people ask Ezekiel why he is sighing, what is he to answer?
options: "Because of the news that it is coming. Every heart will melt, and all hands will be feeble..."
"Because I have seen the Lord in His wrath."
"Because the king of Babylon is dead."
questions.correctAnswer: "Because of the news that it is coming. Every heart will melt, and all hands will be feeble..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:7 (ESV): "And when they say to you, 'Why do you sigh?' you shall say, 'Because of the news that it is coming. Every heart will melt, and all hands will be feeble...'"

questions.question: What song of the sword is Ezekiel commanded to prophesy?
options: "A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished, sharpened for slaughter, polished to flash like lightning!"
"The sword of the Lord is bathed in heaven, it descends upon Edom in judgment!"
"Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, against the man who stands next to me!"
"He has made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand he hid me."
questions.correctAnswer: "A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished, sharpened for slaughter, polished to flash like lightning!"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:9-10 (ESV): "Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, say: A sword, a sword is sharpened and also polished, sharpened for slaughter, polished to flash like lightning!"

questions.question: Why does Ezekiel cry out and wail regarding the sword?
options: Because it is directed against my people, against all the princes of Israel
Because the handle broke in the blacksmith's hand
Because the sword of Babylon was defeated
Because he cut himself with it
questions.correctAnswer: Because it is directed against my people, against all the princes of Israel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:12 (ESV): "Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is directed against my people. It is directed against all the princes of Israel."

questions.question: What action is Ezekiel told to do to emphasize the severity of the sword striking twice, even three times?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:14 (ESV): "As for you, son of man, prophesy. Clap your hands and let the sword come down twice, yes, three times,"

questions.question: God tells Ezekiel to mark out two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to come. Both ways should proceed from where?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:19 (ESV): "Son of man, mark out two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to come. Both of them shall come from one land."

questions.question: The sword of the king of Babylon will come to two places. One is Rabbah of the Ammonites. What is the other?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:20 (ESV): "Make a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the Ammonites and to Judah, into fortified Jerusalem."

questions.question: What three methods of divination does the king of Babylon use at the parting of the ways?
options: He shakes the arrows, he consults the teraphim, he looks at the liver
He rolls dice, he reads the stars, he checks the holy books
He calls up the dead, he reads tea leaves, he watches the birds
He consults a medium, he casts lots, he sacrifices a ram
questions.correctAnswer: He shakes the arrows, he consults the teraphim, he looks at the liver
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:21 (ESV): "For the king of Babylon stands at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination. He shakes the arrows; he consults the teraphim; he looks at the liver."

questions.question: Into which hand does the lot for Jerusalem fall for the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:22 (ESV): "Into his right hand comes the divination for Jerusalem, to set battering rams, to open the mouth with murder,"

questions.question: What does God say to the wicked prince of Israel (Zedekiah)?
options: "Remove the turban and take off the crown. Things shall not remain as they are. Exalt that which is low, and bring low that which is exalted."
"Your throne is established forever, despite your sin."
"You shall reign in Babylon as a puppet king."
questions.correctAnswer: "Remove the turban and take off the crown. Things shall not remain as they are. Exalt that which is low, and bring low that which is exalted."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:26 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: Remove the turban and take off the crown. Things shall not remain as they are. Exalt that which is low, and bring low that which is exalted."

questions.question: "A ruin, ruin, ruin I will make it. This also shall not be, until..."
options: He comes, the one to whom judgment belongs, and I will give it to him
The temple is rebuilt with pure gold
questions.correctAnswer: He comes, the one to whom judgment belongs, and I will give it to him
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:27 (ESV): "A ruin, ruin, ruin I will make it. This also shall not be, until he comes, the one to whom judgment belongs, and I will give it to him." (A Messianic prophecy).

questions.question: Who else will the sword judge, according to the end of the chapter, for their reproach against Israel?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 21:28 (ESV): "And you, son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord God concerning the Ammonites and concerning their reproach; say, A sword, a sword is drawn for the slaughter..."

key_verse_text: "A ruin, ruin, ruin I will make it. This also shall not be, until he comes, the one to whom judgment belongs, and I will give it to him."
